definitions.explanation: An abbreviation of 学校食堂 (school cafeteria). Refers to the on-campus dining facility at a university or college. A casual, everyday term used mainly by students.

examples.japanese: {学食|がくしょく}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{昼|ひる}ご{飯|はん}→昼ご飯：02950_hirugohan⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{食|た}べた→食べる：00396_taberu⟧。
examples.english: I ate lunch at the school cafeteria.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{大学|だいがく}→大学：00608_daigaku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{学食|がくしょく}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{安|やす}くて→安い：00464_yasui⟧おいしい。
examples.english: This university's cafeteria is cheap and delicious.

examples.japanese: ⟦{昼休|ひるやす}み→昼休み：01715_hiruyasumi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{学食|がくしょく}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{学生|がくせい}→学生：00610_gakusei⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧いっぱい⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: The cafeteria gets packed with students during lunch break.

notes:
USAGE:
An abbreviation of ⟦{学校|がっこう}→学校：00055_gakkou⟧⟦{食堂|しょくどう}→食堂：01054_shokudou⟧. Used almost exclusively in reference to university or college dining halls, not elementary or middle school cafeterias. Very common in student conversation.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {学食|がくしょく}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{食|た}べる→食べる：00396_taberu⟧: to eat at the cafeteria
- {学食|がくしょく}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦メニュー→メニュー：11166_menyuu⟧: cafeteria menu
- {学食|がくしょく}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{混|こ}む→混む：02574_komu⟧: the cafeteria is crowded

FORMS:
Abbreviation pattern: ⟦{学|がく}→〜学：09846_gaku⟧ (school) + {食|しょく} (food/dining). This type of two-kanji abbreviation is common in Japanese campus slang.
